about_the_game:
Game Introduction

This is a fully erotic, suspenseful, and romantic love game featuring older, beautiful tops and strong bottoms.

The protagonist can have a custom name, and the main bottom's perspective is the main bottom. Both BL and GB routes are available.

There are 6 possible targets: 4 older men (note the age difference), 1 male of the same age, and 1 beautiful female top.

Currently, the game includes the fully voiced prologue and first chapter, as well as a non-dubbed version of the second chapter.

This game follows the true ending of the adoptive father storyline from the previous game.

If you're looking for a better gaming experience, try the previous game. This game won't affect your experience if you don't.

————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

Game Content

Whether lovers or enemies, they all want to kill you.

This seems to be closely related to your amnesia.

You've been invited to the Stean Manor, owned by Elti, to discover your true self.

And what about ghosts?!?

You scoff, saying there are no such things.

And who is the main guest at this dinner?

————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

Gameplay

You will become the protagonist of this story, Little Gentleman, and you can customize your name in the game.

Faced with various choices that challenge human nature, you must do everything you can to avoid death and survive this dinner party.

The game will lead you to different paths and different endings depending on your choices.

In addition, you can freely choose your favorite playable characters and engage in rich, emotional side stories with them.

This is a choice-driven visual novel with a dark aesthetic. Please enjoy this story to your heart's content.

————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

WARNING!!!

This game contains, but is not limited to:

Incestuous relationships, Blood and violence, BDSM, fetish elements, incest, character deaths, and explicit sexual content.
